notes.title: Full Version DLC has been renamed to Base Set
notes.notes:
Hello Star Realms players!
We've renamed the "Full Version" DLC to "Base Set". Back when it was the only DLC, the Full Version name made more sense, but now that we've got 20+ DLC items, many players found the name confusing or even misleading.

The Base Set purchase still unlocks the same features as before: you get 9 more campaign missions, local Pass & Play multiplayer, and you can play PVP online!

notes.title: How to Play Star Realms with Magic the Gathering Hall of Famer
notes.notes:
Learn to play Star Realms, winner of 7 Game of the year awards, with one of the game designers. Star Realms is free to play against the AI, and only $0.99 during the Steam Tabletop Fest for online play! Star Realms is a spaceship combat deckbuilding game that offers all the thrills of traditional trading card game style combat, combined with the fun of a deckbuilding game. Play powerful ships, destroy enemy bases or blast your opponent directly on your way to victory!  

Rob Dougherty is the co-designer of Star Realms, Hero Realms, Epic Card Game, Sorcerer, Ascension and more. He is the CEO of Wise Wizard Games and has raised over $5M on Kickstarter. Come say hello in chat, follow along, and ask anything you have been wanting to know!

notes.title: Star Realms on the Mac is moving!
notes.notes:
Star Realms will continue to be supported on the Mac, but we have an important update on how Star Realms will be delivered on the Mac. Soon Star Realms will no longer be available on Steam for Mac. Star Realms is now available on the Mac App Store for Mac users, and we will no longer be releasing Mac updates to Steam. We are making this change so that we can streamline updates for all players. For Mac users, we recommend installing Star Realms through the Apple store immediately in order to continue getting updates and support. You can access the Mac App Store by clicking on the apple icon in the top left-hand corner of your Mac display, the App Store is in the main drop-down menu.

[b]When you log in to your Star Realms account, just click on “Restore Purchases” to restore any previously purchased content.[/b]

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/star-realms/id1066107760

We will be removing the Mac version of Star Realms from Steam on Tuesday, February 4.

Star Realms will continue to be supported on Windows. PC users will see no change in support on Steam.

notes.title: Single-player vs AI is free; multiplayer requires purchase
notes.notes:
Everyone at White Wizard Games is excited to finally launch Star Realms on Steam! There has been some confusion about "free to play" and we hope this announcement helps to clear it up. As we say in the full description below, a purchase of the Full Version is required to play online against other players. For a low price, you receive:

•Online play with global rankings.
•Challenge a friend online.
•Play the AI on 3 different difficulty settings.
•9 additional campaign missions.
•Play against opponents regardless of their operating system.

Without purchase, you can play single-player against the AI and play the first campaign mission. Thank you for playing Star Realms!
